visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and cream-colored hair rollers on her forehead addresses the camera. She wears a black top. She holds a transparent plastic package containing a makeup brush. The background is a brightly lit indoor room with a hallway visible behind her. (2) The camera focuses on the text printed on the transparent brush package. The woman's hands hold the package steadily against her chest. The lighting is soft and even across the object. (3) The woman removes the makeup brush from its packaging. She demonstrates the brush's bristles and shape, then brings another larger brush into the frame for a size comparison. Her facial expressions are animated and engaged as she explains the differences. (4) A close-up shot shows the brush head against her palm, highlighting the slanted bristle design. She uses her fingers to fan the bristles out. White arrows appear on the screen to indicate the direction of the bristle taper. (5) The woman holds up a small, round, pink container of blush. She points to the label on the box. The scene cuts back and forth between her face and the product. (6) She opens the blush container to reveal a puff inside and then shows the loose powder. She dabs the brush into the powder and applies it to her cheek. (7) The woman presses the brush onto a white tissue, showing a light orange-pink smudge. She then demonstrates how to tap the brush on her hand to remove excess powder before applying it to her face. (8) In a close-up, she applies the blush under her eyes and on her cheekbones. She looks into a small handheld mirror while smiling and nodding. (9) The woman holds both the blush container and the brush next to her face, smiling broadly. Text overlays summarize her recommendation for the products.
